messages:
hani: quick sync on playground streaming UI. want a compact approach that reduces jumps. tradeoffs we should call out: overlay stop vs inline stop, where to surface token counts (micro-pill vs global footer), undo behavior if a user stops, and making save-to-prompt-library easy mid-stream.

omar: overlay stop icon avoids layout shifting. show it as low-contrast until hover/focus. on mobile show an inline "Stop stream" action under the message.

lucy: copy: prefer 'Pause stream' (less alarming) and toast: 'Stream paused  Resume' with an accessible Undo button. token pill should read like "~120 tokens" while streaming; exact in tooltip.

dev: implementation notes: overlay is straightforward with absolute positioning; ensure it doesn't break text selection (pointer-events handling). throttle token updates to 200ms to avoid repaint churn. add API: pauseStream(messageId), resumeStream(messageId, resumeToken?) and saveSnippet(messageId, cursorPos?).

maya: prompt-library UX: add a "Save snippet" ghost control that appears on hover/focus and copies current partial text + context metadata. saving shouldn't interrupt the stream. on save show a small accessible confirmation with role="status": "Snippet saved to Prompt Library."

hani: a11y: streaming partial updates should use a per-message aria-live="polite" region that updates at most once per second to avoid verbose SR output. on pause, move focus to the toast Resume button and announce "Streaming paused; final partial content available." on resume announce "Resuming stream." When resuming, set aria-atomic="false" on the resumed fragment so screen readers only read new tokens.

omar: mobile fallback: overlay hidden, inline actions in footer. token pill collapses to a single icon that opens a modal with breakdown (visible vs estimate).

lucy: tooltip copy suggestion: title "Token breakdown" with two lines: "Visible tokens: 134" and "Estimated billable: 210". include a small link "How billed" linking to docs.

dev: technical: billable estimate can be computed in background using local tokenizer; show approximate immediately and update tooltip when accurate value returns. analytics: tag pause_method (button/shortcut), resume_source (undo/keyboard), save_snippet_midstream.

maya: save-snippet UI: accessible label "Save current response to Prompt Library" and keyboard shortcut S when message focused. optimistic animation and fallback error toast if save fails.

hani: UX decision proposal: desktop = overlay Pause icon + token micro-pill bottom-left; mobile = inline Pause in footer + compact token action; toast with Resume/Undo for 6s that focuses on the Resume button; Save snippet visible on hover or in message menu on mobile.

maya: small microcopy nit: prefer 'Resume' on the toast not 'Undo' to be explicit.

dev: keyboard: Esc pauses the stream, Cmd+. pause alternative, R triggers regenerate when focused. will add focus traps so keyboard users can get to controls.

a11y-bot: automated note: detected aria-live usage. ensure role=status on toast and include aria-labels for overlay controls before merging.
